issue.title: [DocDB] Fix race condition with Webserver::access_logging_enabled

repository.name: yugabyte-db
repository.description: YugabyteDB - the cloud native distributed SQL database for mission-critical applications.

issue.body:
Jira Link: [DB-13131](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-13131)
### Description

The test PgCatalogPerfTest_ResponseCacheInvalidationOnConnectionWithTempTableClosure finds a data race under tsan.

 In particular, the following field:
```
~/code/yugabyte-db/src/yb/server/webserver.cc:139:
  bool access_logging_enabled = false;
```
is both read by:
```
~/code/yugabyte-db/src/yb/server/webserver.cc:592:
  if (access_logging_enabled) {
```
while simultaneously to by:
```
~/code/yugabyte-db/src/yb/yql/pggate/webserver/pgsql_webserver_wrapper.cc:675:
void SetWebserverConfig(
    WebserverWrapper *webserver_wrapper, bool enable_access_logging, bool enable_tcmalloc_logging,
    int webserver_profiler_sample_freq_bytes) {
  Webserver *webserver = reinterpret_cast<Webserver *>(webserver_wrapper);
  webserver->SetLogging(enable_access_logging, enable_tcmalloc_logging);
```

This task is to fix this data race by adding a spin lock.
